name: Lectio 365
shortDescription: A free UK charity-operated mobile app for daily Bible-based prayer and devotionals, with read-and-listen sessions, themed series and limited offline access.
suitableContexts: Individuals or small groups seeking a guided daily Bible-prayer rhythm
Churches signposting a free devotional resource rather than administering member data
Families using the separate Lectio for Families resource with adult guidance

pricing.summary: 24-7 Prayer states that Lectio 365 is free for everyone and funded by donations.

tiers.label: Lectio 365 app
tiers.detail: Supplier states that the app is funded by donations.

gdprInformation: Lectio 365 publishes an app-specific privacy notice. It says no account, name, email address or phone number is required, while limited technical, usage and identifier data may be collected for analytics and performance monitoring. It says some app data may be processed outside the UK with stated safeguards. This does not make it suitable for storing church pastoral, safeguarding or children’s records.
coreFeatures: Morning, midday and night Bible-based devotionals
One-week advance download for offline listening
integrations: No church-management, giving or group-data integration is documented in the reviewed material
importExport: No user-data import or export workflow is documented in the reviewed material
support: Supplier says content is available through the iOS and Android app stores

uk-operator.value: 24-7 Prayer is a registered UK charity (1091413) and Companies House records 24-7 PRAYER as company 04176643.

product-scope.value: Supplier describes Lectio 365 as a free daily prayer app with morning, midday and night devotionals, themed series, read-and-listen modes, offline downloads and a 30-day archive.

free-access.value: Supplier states that Lectio 365 is free for everyone and funded by donations.

app-privacy.value: The app privacy notice says no account or direct contact details are required, identifies limited technical and usage data collection, and notes that some data may be processed outside the UK with safeguards.

editorial.assessment: Lectio 365 is a polished, narrowly focused devotional app from a UK Christian charity. It can be useful as a shared formation resource for church members or small groups, particularly where people value audio as well as written material. It is not an administration platform and is best introduced as an optional resource: it has no documented church-data integrations, group-management tools or shared study workspace.
bestFor: Church members building a daily Scripture and prayer rhythm
Small groups looking for a common but flexible devotional prompt
Churches that want to signpost a free, UK charity-operated individual resource
strengths: Free access stated by the supplier
UK charity operator with public app-specific privacy information
Daily rhythm and themed series provide structure without a fixed start date
limitations: An individual devotional app, not a collaborative Bible-study platform or church-management system
No public group administration, attendance, pastoral-record, safeguarding or church-data workflow
Content is primarily designed for adults; the supplier directs families to a separate resource
No documented data export or church-system integration

procurementVerdict.problem: Helping people develop a consistent Scripture-and-prayer rhythm outside gathered church activities
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A free UK charity-operated app combining short daily Bible-based prayer, audio and limited offline use
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask a small adult group to try the app for two weeks, then decide whether its theological approach, daily rhythm and accessibility work for the church; do not use it to collect or store church member information
